items.label: Kingsemi annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
items.signal_prefix: R&D and technology (annual report): 2025 R&D expense RMB 254,508,089.06

set.signal: R&D and technology (annual report): 2025 R&D expense RMB 254,508,089.06 (-14.21%), 13.06% of revenue (16.92% in 2024); R&D staff rose to 643 from 459 (35.84% of employees). Main projects: coater/developer and bonding equipment and core units R&D and industrialisation (budget RMB 694,315,000.00; its work includes thermal-compression bonding technology), single-wafer wet equipment (RMB 320,297,500.00) and core components (RMB 135,090,000.00). A next-generation track architecture matched to higher lithography-scanner throughput is progressing in development, and the company will push its process validation and sales as soon as possible; its high-end front-end tracks already run inline in volume production with mainstream global scanners. Patents granted: 405, including 241 inventions.

items.reason: The RMB 694,315,000.00 budget belongs to the whole 'coater/developer and bonding equipment and core units R&D and industrialisation' project; thermal-compression bonding is only one research item within it, not the budgeted project.

items.label: Kinwong annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)

set.signal: Capacity (annual report): seven production bases - Shenzhen, Longchuan, Jishui, Xinfeng, Zhuhai Jinwan, Zhuhai Fushan and Thailand (under construction). At Zhuhai Jinwan, the base for AI server products (high-order HDI, HLC, SLP), part of the expansion lines went into production in 2025; the high-order HDI plant construction was 32.32% of its RMB 25,608.00 ten-thousand budget; the convertible-bond HDI (including SLP) project (RMB 113,961.54 ten-thousand planned, 97.03% invested) lists February 2026 as its intended usable-state date and was not yet closed. The Ganzhou (Xinfeng) high-layer PCB base phase 1 started production in January 2025 and ramped smoothly. Zhuhai Kinwong subsidiary 2025 revenue RMB 217,380.95 ten-thousand with a net loss of RMB 10,892.69 ten-thousand.
set.figure: Zhuhai high-order HDI plant 32.32% of RMB 25,608.00 ten-thousand budget; HDI (SLP) project intended usable-state date February 2026

items.reason: The raised-fund table gives February 2026 as the project's intended usable-state date with 'closed: no'; the report does not state that the project actually reached usable state.

items.label: Linktel Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 2025 annual report: optical modules (including contract-processed modules)

set.signal: 2025 annual report: optical modules (including contract-processed modules) had 2025 capacity of 418 ten-thousand units, output 302 and sales 286 ten-thousand units (2024: 427 / 251 / 246 ten-thousand), revenue RMB 1,238,669,249.10 at a 34.00% gross margin, with high-speed products a rising share. Phases 1 and 2 of the Malaysia (Penang) capacity are fully in operation and phase 3 is being prepared; the Malaysia manufacturing base project is 100% complete (cumulative investment RMB 108,961,523.21) and the Malaysian subsidiary had 2025 operating revenue of RMB 733,216,063.10. 400G-and-above modules sold overseas: 27 ten-thousand units for RMB 633,050,718.24. Inventory rose to RMB 961,677,060.75 (start of year RMB 539,714,655.10) and operating cash flow was RMB -206,196,445.26, mainly from paying for stockpiled materials.

items.reason: RMB 733,216,063.10 is the Malaysian subsidiary's operating revenue (its net profit was RMB 18,275,935.62); 'earned' read as profit.
